dog.title: Akamaru, the ninja dog
dog.text: Akamaru will be part of the party, but don’t expect a particularly sociable dog. He will bark when he sees you, perhaps ask for a stroke, then promptly ignore you. We expect some barking, so don’t worry. One important thing: please don’t feed him, even if he begs with those eyes. Some of the food will be dangerous for dogs and we don’t want to take risks. Thank you!
dog.name: Akamaru · 赤丸
